versions.changelog: Made the skill more generic by removing personal and scientist-specific references.

- Initial release of yc-cold-outreach.
- Provides expert guidance on Y Combinator cold outreach techniques.
- Includes pre-flight targeting checklist and the 7 YC email principles.
- Supports drafting, critiquing, and iterating on cold emails for customers, partners, and scientists.
- Features "YC Grade" review framework for email quality.
- Offers example phrasing and mobile-friendly best practices.
